# lotabin

> lotabin is a short-form video ad production desk and motion picture studio in Nagoya, Japan. One producer-led desk scripts, storyboards and produces launch-ready short-form video ads for brands, founders, in-house teams, agencies and media buyers — typically script-to-launch in about 10 days. Bilingual (English / Japanese). Founded by Yuya Kagawa. Contact: yuya@lotabin.com.

lotabin runs a fixed-scope, fixed-deadline production line: you get a defined scope and delivery date before a single frame is shot. The model is a "creative farm" — an in-house producer directing a vetted, worldwide network of specialist writers, conceptual artists, directors, DOPs and editors, so a brand gets one accountable point of contact instead of managing freelancers. lotabin also operates lotabin Entertainment, a motion picture studio.

## What lotabin does
- Short-form video ads (paid social, performance creative, product spots, founder stories, hooks packs)
- Scripts, storyboards and creative direction
- Creative testing — multiple sales-angle variations for media buyers
- Bilingual production (EN / JA)
- Film production via lotabin Entertainment

## Services & pricing
- [Services overview](https://lotabin.com/services.html): why teams run a fixed-cost creative system instead of a hire, plus the full tier lineup.
- [Instant Ad Blueprint — $299](https://lotabin.com/blueprint.html): self-serve AI creative draft (1 product / 1 USP, 3 hooks, 6 scripted angles + storyboards), delivered in 24h as a branded PDF. No human revisions.
- [Sprout — Creative Pilot, $149 one-time](https://lotabin.com/services-sprout.html): the paid proof of quality — two human-directed creative directions, one finished 15-second video, one revision round.
- [Standard — Campaign Builder, $997/mo](https://lotabin.com/services-standard.html): one offer turned into six monthly Creative Tests, each a different sales angle, with a Media Buyer Handoff Kit.
- [Pro — Creative Testing Engine, $1,997/mo](https://lotabin.com/services-pro.html): 12 Creative Tests across two production waves, the second informed by performance, with a monthly Creative Learnings report.
- [Scale — Creative Department, from $3,497/mo](https://lotabin.com/services-enterprise.html): an ongoing creative partner with a dedicated creative lead for launches, collections and multi-product growth.
- [Film Studio](https://lotabin.com/services-film.html): motion picture production.
- [For Agencies / Partners](https://lotabin.com/services-partners.html): white-label production for agencies and media buyers.
